newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Light's Shandong project approved.
newsitem.headline: China Light's Shandong project approved.

text.p: China Light and Power Co Ltd said its proposed power plant project in China's Shandong province has been approved by China's State Council.

"The joint venture contract and articles of association have been submitted to the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation for approval, following which the joint venture company will be formed," it said in its first quarter report for 1997 published on Monday.
The proposed four-power-station project would have a total capacity of 3,220 megawatts (MW), it added.
China Light also said a memorandum of understanding for the development of a 1,050 MW gas-fired combined cycle plant at Qianwan, Shenzhen, was signed last October.
China Light was expected to take a 35 percent stake in the project worth an estimated 7-8 billion yuan, Shenzhen's executive vice mayor Li Decheng said late last year.
